headline: JBF Industries submits SEBI Takeover Regulation 31(4) disclosure of substantial acquisition
sum: JBF Industries Limited filed a mandatory disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4), indicating a substantial acquisition of shares triggering takeover code obligations.
detail: JBF Industries Limited submitted a formal disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 to the NSE. This disclosure is mandatory when an acquirer crosses defined shareholding thresholds (typically 25% or higher). The filing indicates entry into the regulated acquisition phase; the acquiring party and precise shareholding, consideration amount, and timetable for any open offer would be detailed in the full disclosure document.
